exposure: Stage I late-onset fetal growth restriction (FGR)
cohort: 131 fetuses with stage I late-onset FGR (diagnosis ≥32+0 weeks)
finding: In fetuses with stage I late-onset FGR, abnormal fetal Doppler is associated with a higher rate of cesarean section, even when birth weight is > 10th centile.
mod_finding: Abnormal fetal Doppler is associated with a poorer tolerance to vaginal delivery in fetuses with stage I late-onset FGR.
